caption: The drawing depicts a detailed architectural scene consisting of several elements arranged in a vertical format. At the top left, there is the façade of a building with two sets of green shuttered windows, a decorative wrought iron balcony adorned with flower boxes containing multicolored flowers, and a matching ornate wrought iron railing with swirling and geometric patterns. To the right, there is an entrance with a double door, flanked by potted shrubs, accessed by a set of stairs, and covered by an overhang supported by elaborately patterned ironwork. The building's wall appears to be in light brown and beige tones, while the overhang’s underside is a light blue. Below this central section, there is a square garden detail bordered in red brick and filled with green foliage, featuring a white ornamental urn overflowing with white flowers on a pedestal. To the right of this, there are two designs for iron lamp posts with lanterns and a design for wrought iron fencing, all colored in a dark blue or black, shown both in isolation and in relation to one another. The floor in the lower sections is composed of cream and beige squares arranged diagonally. The entire composition is rendered in watercolor, with soft and muted hues, emphasizing the contrast between the intricate ironwork and the masonry.
title: Ornamental Iron
